title: Bug to butterfly: the "be gentle" glow-up carousel
summary: Slide one: your awkward old photo with a little bug sticker and "Ew, squish it!". Slide two: butterflies. Then your glow-up photos, each with "Be gentle".
why: Jump on the Trend added it on November 8, 2026 (page updated November 9). It says a three-slide bug-to-butterfly glow-up post on TikTok from October 27 had about 5.6 million views, a template version from November 1 had about 1.1 million, and it estimates about 8.9 million views across posts. It's a new spin on the glow-up flip, told as a little story.
steps: Pick one awkward or unflattering old photo of yourself, and five to eight photos of you now that you love.
Use the first prompt on the old photo, the second to make the butterfly slide, and the third on each of your new photos.
Put them in order as a photo carousel or a fast slideshow: bug slide, butterfly slide, then the glow-up photos.
Add a soft, dreamy sound from the app's library and post it. The captions on the slides tell the story.

prompts.label: Slide 1: the bug photo
prompts.text: Edit my photo. Keep my face and the scene exactly the same. Make the colours a little flat and grey, like a dull, cloudy day. Add one small cartoon sticker of a brown beetle-like bug in a corner, drawn in a simple, cute cut-out sticker style with a white border. Add short text near the top in a plain white font with a thin black outline: "Ew, squish it!". Vertical 4:5. No other text, no logos.

prompts.label: Slide 2: the butterflies
prompts.text: Make a vertical 4:5 image: a pure black background filled with dozens of orange and black butterflies in flight, at different sizes, some sharp and some soft and blurred, as if they're bursting toward the camera. A soft golden glow in the middle. No text, no logos.

prompts.label: Slides 3 and on: the glow-up
prompts.text: Edit my photo. Keep my face, body and the scene exactly the same. Give it a warm golden-hour glow, soft and bright, like the best version of the day. Add one small orange and black butterfly sticker in a corner, in a simple cut-out sticker style with a white border. Add short text near the top in a plain white font with a thin black outline: "Be gentle". Vertical 4:5. No other text, no logos.

prompts.label: Variation: small business glow-up
prompts.text: Edit this photo of our shop, product or work from our early days. Keep it real and recognizable. Make it flat and grey and add a small cartoon bug sticker in a corner with the text "Ew, squish it!". Then, for a second image, take a photo of how it looks today, give it a warm golden-hour glow and add a small orange and black butterfly sticker with the text "Be gentle". Both vertical 4:5, plain white font with a thin black outline. No other text, no logos, no brand names.

tips: Pick an old photo you can laugh at. The trend is playful, not a put-down.
Keep the edits light. Your glow-up photos should still look like you, just warmer.
Use the same sticker style and font on every slide so the set feels like one story.
Only use photos of other people, like a friend's glow-up, if they've said yes.
